execution_context: One fresh regular non-project image-generation chat. Do not provide project history, competing prompts, prior images, Director prior, Stage imagery or brand/project names.
renderer_visible_prompt: Create one uninterrupted wide 16:9 artwork containing exactly three distinct, specific adults in one shared sparse, temporally non-specific world. The left and central adults carry the strongest present relationship; the third adult remains clearly specific and relevant, offset asymmetrically rather than forming a lineup. Before this depicted moment, one completed human action changed the shared present; the act is over. Make the changed condition perceptible through blocking, orientation, overlap, contact, obstruction, negative space or modest physical residue, without explaining motive, belief, knowledge, diagnosis, emotion or hidden mental state. Use authored stylized human figures, not photorealism. Make each person individually recoverable through a sparse set of recurring non-color structural cues distributed across silhouette, proportion, contour, hair/body geometry and internal form rhythm; facial detail may contribute but must not be the sole recognition cue. Keep the figures unmistakably human and visually primary. Let relationship emerge through the people and shared space rather than diagrams or connectors. Keep the environment quiet, planar to shallow in depth and subordinate to the adults. Any physical response must remain attributable to specific people and must never become spectacle. Compose asymmetrically so the left adult primarily occupies roughly the left 10–34% of the image, the central adult roughly 38–66%, and the third adult roughly 68–92% with a deliberate vertical or depth offset. Preserve useful authored body/form information near the image edges so partial crops remain meaningful, but do not turn the scene into a character-select sheet. Do not make this fashion or editorial portraiture, profile-avatar imagery, game-character art, mascot design, cinematic concept art or a psychology illustration. Do not use one giant symbolic object, magical effects, glow, aura, portals, beams, nodes, arrows, UI, text, labels, logos, spotlight/theater staging, cone lineups or recognizable stage scenery. Do not prescribe or depend on a brand palette; value, form, contact and geometry must carry the artwork. Return only the uninterrupted artwork.
return_contract: One uninterrupted artwork only; no explanation, variants, contact sheet or critique.
post_return: Preserve the untouched output in the exact Drive folder before Design Sol scoring; record Drive ID, SHA-256, bytes and pixel dimensions. Do not edit, reroll, inpaint, outpaint or upscale.
